nodes.title: The plugin's board setup works as written in every host repo (yarn, pnpm, npm)
The /design agent following BOARD-SETUP.md in a host repo
Registering blueprint-mcp and launching the board succeed on the first try in teselly and kixie
BOARD-SETUP.md: src/ paths, <pm> run blueprint:board, checkout resolution order, board-build line; test needles; version bump
Every live stale packages/ blueprint path in the plugin repointed (design-map skill, script, schema comment, test, fixtures)

forks.title: Should the preflight work out the board launch line, or should the agent read it off the repo by following the doc?

card.problem: BOARD-SETUP §4 tells the agent to offer the repo's launch line and then names a yarn command, which is wrong in kixie (pnpm, and its script needs BLUEPRINT_CHECKOUT). The /design preflight already reports on-disk facts such as .blueprint/, the .mcp.json registration and the board on :3727, but not how this repo launches the board. Either the doc carries the rule and the agent applies it each run, or the preflight prints it as a tested fact.
useCases: teselly: yarn, script present, sibling blueprint checkout
kixie: pnpm, script present, needs BLUEPRINT_CHECKOUT
a host repo with no blueprint:board script

options.label: The preflight prints a board_script verdict with the launch line

walks.text: The preflight sees pnpm and the script's BLUEPRINT_CHECKOUT use, and the agent offers that line verbatim.
walks.given: a pnpm host repo whose blueprint:board script reads BLUEPRINT_CHECKOUT
walks.then: it prints board_script: present with launch: pnpm run blueprint:board (needs BLUEPRINT_CHECKOUT)

walks.text: The preflight reports no script, and the agent offers the direct node line.
walks.given: a host repo with no blueprint:board script
walks.then: it prints board_script: absent and the doc's fallback is the direct node src/apps/sticky-notes-board/bin/blueprint-board.mjs line

options.label: The doc spells out the rule and the agent derives the line each time

walks.text: The agent reads packageManager and the script itself at offer time, and nothing tests that it gets it right.
walks.given: a pnpm host repo whose blueprint:board script reads BLUEPRINT_CHECKOUT
walks.when: the agent reaches the board offer
walks.then: it must derive pnpm run blueprint:board with the variable set from the doc's prose

recommendation.why: It turns a judgement the agent repeats on every run into a fact that is tested under two shells, which is the reason the preflight exists. It also costs one row and two fixtures.

card.ifOverturned: Drop the preflight change; §4 carries the three checks in prose, and the test pins only 'run blueprint:board'.

forks.title: Should this ticket fix only the board-setup doc, or every place in the plugin that still points at blueprint's old packages/ layout?

card.problem: Besides BOARD-SETUP.md, the old packages/ layout appears in the design-map skill, scripts/design-map.py, a schema comment, the design-map test, three fixtures and a fixture README. The design-map test's vocabulary check fails whenever someone points it at a real blueprint checkout, because it looks in packages/blueprint-schema/, while the copy is actually in sync. The gate never sets the variable, so the check has silently been a skip.
useCases: a reader follows the design-map skill's pointer to blueprint's schema
a maintainer runs the vocabulary check against a blueprint checkout

options.label: Sweep every live stale path in the plugin in the same release

walks.text: The check finds blueprint's schema at its real path and passes.
walks.given: BLUEPRINT_CHECKOUT set to a blueprint checkout at cd44e8e3
walks.then: the vocabulary copy is compared with src/packages/backend/blueprint-schema/schema/map.schema.json and reported fresh

options.label: Fix BOARD-SETUP.md only; the rest waits for a follow-up

walks.text: The check stays red against a real checkout until a follow-up lands.
walks.given: BLUEPRINT_CHECKOUT set to a blueprint checkout at cd44e8e3
walks.then: it fails 'BLUEPRINT_CHECKOUT holds the emitted map.schema.json' with no file at packages/blueprint-schema/...

recommendation.why: It is the same defect, in the same repo and the same release, about a dozen lines. Leaving it means a second plugin bump later for the identical fix.

card.ifOverturned: Ship BOARD-SETUP only and file a plugin follow-up for the remaining stale paths.
